definitions.explanation: Kanji characters that were created in Japan rather than imported from China. Also called {国字|こくじ} (kokuji). Examples include {峠|とうげ} (mountain pass), {畑|はたけ} (field), and {込|こ} (to include).
In a broader sense, refers to Japanese writing systems (hiragana and katakana) as distinguished from Chinese characters ({漢字|かんじ}).

examples.japanese: 「⟦{峠|とうげ}→峠：02227_touge⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{和字|わじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつだ。
examples.english: The character 峠 (mountain pass) is one of the representative Japanese-made kanji.

examples.japanese: {和字|わじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風土|ふうど}→風土：14628_fuudo⟧や⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}して→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese-made characters were created to reflect Japan's natural environment and culture.

examples.japanese: {和字|わじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}われない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Among Japanese-made characters, there are many kanji that are not used in China.

examples.japanese: {平安時代|へいあんじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{和字|わじ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{仮名|かな}→仮名：03979_kana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Kana developed as Japanese writing during the Heian period.

examples.japanese: {和字|わじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせた→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦{表記|ひょうき}→表記：14123_hyouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ。
examples.english: The combination of kana and kanji in writing is a characteristic feature of Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古文書|こもんじょ}→古文書：15839_komonjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和字|わじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{漢文|かんぶん}→漢文：13398_kanbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混在|こんざい}→混在：13352_konzai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Old documents contain a mix of Japanese writing and classical Chinese text.

notes:
Composed of {和|わ} (Japan/Japanese) and ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧ (character/writing). The word has two main uses depending on context.

In sense 1 (Japanese-made kanji), well-known examples include:
- ⟦{峠|とうげ}→峠：02227_touge⟧: mountain pass (mountain + up + down)
- ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧: dry field (fire + field)
- ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧: to be crowded (movement + enter)
- {辻|つじ}: crossroads
- ⟦{躾|しつけ}→躾：10342_shitsuke⟧: discipline/training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国字|こくじ}→国字：28106_kokuji⟧: Japanese-made kanji — a synonym for sense 1, more commonly used in linguistics
- ⟦{仮名|かな}→仮名：03979_kana⟧: kana — the phonetic scripts (hiragana/katakana)
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧: kanji — Chinese characters, the broader category
